mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over the past month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE rises above 4.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth (quarterly year-over-year) and low inflation (monthly CPI) signals a healthy economic expansion without overheating, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (GDPC1 growth and CPIAUCSL low) fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened risk aversion from aggressive policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for the regime condition falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 over the past two months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past three months indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has increased over the prior three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 370,000 million dollars over the past month signals weak consumer spending, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS < 370000, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
